name: 学术论文
description: 学术期刊严肃感：纯白 + Times New Roman + 超小字 12-13px + 行距 1.7 + italic H3 + 超细分章节。H1 16px uppercase 纯黑、H2 14px italic 编号感、H3 13px italic 缩进、p 12px 首行缩进 2em 两端对齐、blockquote 左双线内嵌。论文派严肃（vs broadsheet 报刊密集派，vs newspaper 新闻派）。适合研究报告/深度分析/综述/严肃评论。

styles.container: background-color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Times New Roman','Times','Songti SC','PingFang SC',serif;
styles.h1: font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; color: #0F0F0F; text-align: center; line-height: 1.3; margin-top: 36px; margin-bottom: 26px; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; font-style: italic; color: #0F0F0F; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
styles.h3: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; font-style: italic; color: #1A3A6E; line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 10px; padding-left: 16px;
styles.h4: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #0F0F0F; line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 8px; padding-left: 24px;
styles.h5: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #333333; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.45; padding-left: 24px;
styles.h6: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #666666; margin-top: 14px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.45;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #0F0F0F; line-height: 1.75; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; text-align: justify; letter-spacing: 0.3px;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 3px double #0F0F0F; font-size: 12px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.7; background: transparent; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 12px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 0; background: transparent;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; display: block; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; border: 1px solid #CCCCCC; background: transparent;
styles.hr: margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px; height: 0; border: none; border-top: 1px solid #0F0F0F; width: 40px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;
styles.code: background: #F5F5F5; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 88%; color: #1A3A6E; font-family: 'Courier New','SF Mono',monospace;
styles.pre: background: #FAFAFA; border: 1px solid #DDDDDD; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #0F0F0F; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.65; white-space: pre-wrap;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; background: #EEEEEE; color: #666666; font-size: 10px; font-style: italic;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #0F0F0F; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Courier New','SF Mono',monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; font-size: 12px;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: #0F0F0F; background: transparent; border-top: 2px solid #0F0F0F; border-bottom: 1px solid #0F0F0F; font-style: italic;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #0F0F0F; line-height: 1.75; letter-spacing: 0.3px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 4px; align-items: flex-start;
